name: agent-project-governance
description: Start, checkpoint, deliver, and close bounded engineering work without a second plan

interface.shortDescription: Start, resume, deliver, and verify bounded engineering work.
interface.longDescription: A developer-preview governance layer for existing-project intake, optional project bootstrap, actor-scoped checkpoints, bounded delivery, and evidence-based closeout. It reuses project authorities and engineering tools rather than creating another plan or orchestration system.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project and preview its governance setup.
Resume this work unit and recommend the next safe action.
Refresh this task's workspace evidence before writing.
Verify the current candidate before merge or cleanup.
